feedback.goal: Close audit P0-4 and P0-5: the e2e driver applies the declared model via a patch overlay and records the composition pin; run records separate harness execution outcome from grader-derived business outcome.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The e2e driver generates a model-patch overlay from the declared provider/model, passes it to dsh headless (local and docker), and pins its digest in the run record (context.model_patch_sha256 + harness_pins).

Run records carry business_outcome (status/source/score/earned/total) from the deterministic grader while outcome stays the harness execution status; the recorder emits business_outcome null explicitly.
Schema changes are additive and the full gate passes on the branch.

outcome.summary: Model provenance and business-outcome split landed: the declared route is now applied via a patch overlay with its digest pinned, and grader results ride business_outcome while outcome remains execution status only.

what_worked: The patch mechanism mirrors the governed proposer's existing model-patch pattern, so the declared model and the effective composition now agree by construction.
The recorder's explicit business_outcome null keeps 'no grader receipt' distinguishable from a passed business check.

evidence.summary: Patch overlay content and a schema-valid record carrying business_outcome plus model_patch_sha256; recorder business_outcome null asserted in plugin-modes tests.

uncertainty.statement: The driver cannot observe the runtime request route from the headless stdout; the patch makes the declared composition effective, but route observation still requires the run-mode recorder's request/context projection.
uncertainty.resolution: When the mode bundle is mounted in the workbench profile, the recorder's provider/model projection plus the patch digest give the declared-vs-observed pairing the review asks for.

notes: Deterministic harness changes only; no model calls or external transfers in this round.
